note: Claude Code plugins, off by default; opt in with --plugin NAME. The kit declares them in .claude/settings.json (kit-owned keys extraKnownMarketplaces/<marketplace>, an inline 'settings' marketplace whose plugin sources are pinned to a commit sha, and enabledPlugins/<plugin>@<marketplace>) and, behind the network gate, installs them on this PC with the claude CLI (kit/plugin_install.py). Codex plugins (agents: codex, source url or git-subdir) go into the kit-owned .agents/plugins/marketplace.json and, behind the same gate, are installed with the codex CLI; Codex has no install scope, so the plugin is enabled in every project (~/.codex/config.toml). Sources must be full https:// URLs.

security-guidance.disabled_reason: its hooks create ~/.claude/security/agent-sdk-venv and pip-install the Agent SDK at session start, and send git diffs to the Anthropic API on stop (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or your Claude Code sign-in). Opt in with --plugin security-guidance
security-guidance.network_egress: PyPI at session start; git diffs to the Anthropic API
security-guidance.file_access: the repository diff; writes a venv and state under ~/.claude/security/

credentials.purpose: LLM review of git diffs on stop; without it the plugin uses your Claude Code sign-in (/login), else runs only its pattern warnings

security-guidance.pin_note: kept at ff920a4094a3 (plugin 2.0.17). Upstream 2.0.18 changes its hooks; review that diff before moving the pin (2026-11-08)

filetree.disabled_reason: Claude Code mod (IDE-style file tree pane) that runs its own code in every session; v0.8.2 needs Claude Code 2.1.306 or later. Opt in with --plugin filetree
filetree.network_egress: none found when its code was read (2026-11-08)
filetree.file_access: reads the workspace file tree and git status; no writes to home settings found

replay-theater.disabled_reason: Claude Code mod with hooks (hooks/hooks.json, replay-theater.mjs) that steps through the last turn's edits; needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later. Opt in with --plugin replay-theater
replay-theater.file_access: reads the edits of the last turn

savvy-progress.disabled_reason: Claude Code mod (progress bar and agents panel) that runs its own code in every session. Opt in with --plugin savvy-progress
savvy-progress.network_egress: none found when its code was read (2026-11-08)
savvy-progress.file_access: reads session and subagent state; no writes to home settings found

effortless.disabled_reason: calls Haiku on every prompt (and for every compaction) on your Claude login; its in-app Update button copies a newer version over the pinned one, bypassing the pin; a key pasted into its setup guide is stored in plain text in ~/.config/jev/.env; it needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 in your user settings, which the kit does not set. Opt in with --plugin effortless
effortless.network_egress: Anthropic API (Haiku) for every prompt; TypeSafe (Jev) when a key is set; git checks for new versions
effortless.file_access: reads the conversation to judge effort; may write ~/.config/jev/.env (plain text key) when a key is pasted in its setup guide

credentials.purpose: optional faster effort judge (Jev); without it Haiku judges on your Claude login. Prefer `/plugin configure` in Claude Code (secure storage) over pasting it into the setup guide
